notes: Grounded in raw/semafor.json (computed-style frequencies, craft, architecture) + the 11-frame sequence + desktop/mobile screenshots. raw/semafor.html (843k tokens) and raw/semafor.css (129k tokens) are single-line minified bundles that exceeded the reader's limit and could not be inspected directly; every value below is therefore a computed or sampled value, not a source declaration. The site authors exactly ONE CSS custom property (`--scroll-behavior: smooth`) — it has no token layer, so all names here are assigned roles, not the site's. Colors are exact rgb() computed values converted to hex. `scroll_effects`: the probe's `rotate 49.2°` on the clock hand is DROPPED as a scroll effect — the 11 frames are pixel-identical apart from the hands, proving the document never scrolled (a load-time newsletter modal locks it); the rotation is a 60s infinite loop sampled at two times. The three probe `pin (fixed)` entries are the modal/drawer, reclassified as in-view opacity, not scroll-progress. Type scale normalized to rem from computed px (10/12/13/15/16/20/24/31/42); 13.3333px and 14.5px are browser em-fallback artifacts and were dropped, as were the 9px and 8px micro-labels below the legible floor. Weights 600/700 (13 elements) are synthetic bolding of the Helvetica fallback, not axis instances — dropped from the ramp. Spacing base recorded as 5px (not 8px): the padding/gap ladder is 4/5/10/12/18/20/30/50, with 12px inline padding the one off-grid step. `shadow` is empty because `craft.elevation.shadows` is empty — the page has none. `color.dark` OMITTED: `craft.theme.supportsDark` is false; the `craft.theme.dark` payload is a degenerate re-read of the light palette (bg #f8f5d7, accent transparent) and was not used. `reduced_motion: unknown` — the probe flags `respectsReducedMotion: true` off a single @media rule among 48 stylesheets, which belongs to the Termly consent widget; the site's own clock loop is unguarded.
